Definitely a hidden gem; Solatorobo was made by CyberConnect2 as a spiritual sequel to the cult classic Tail Concerto for the Sony Playstation. This game has similar gameplay to that title, but also includes some key changes; the art style is improved drastically, locales are much more varied, and story also has a more dramatic tone.

Sound design is decent; though there is some noticeable compression in regards to the characters attacks. The soundtrack is very nice, and most new copies will come with a physical copy of it with 24 full tracks as well... the game also has many of these tracks as unlockables, in-game. In fact; cut-scenes, concept art, and music + ambient sounds are ALL available for your pleasure, once unlocked.

Beyond that, though; graphics are some of the most technically impressive for the system. There isn't much to say here, other than to see for yourself! It also keeps a high framerate, with almost no noticeable slowdown.

It's certainly not for everyone, as it's gameplay is rather unorthodox for a game of it's type; but it also gets better later on. If you enjoyed the DS Zelda games, but are looking for a bit of a different take on the adventure genre - this could definitely be a game that you would enjoy.
